'''2007 Endor Regionals Mark Sebring LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Sebring]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' LS Lightsaber Combat
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
